summary: Repaired the legacy mail-spool replay workflow on node1. Recovery is Message-ID-based, idempotent, preserves the original spool and prior delivery, quarantines malformed mail with an explanation, and persisted across a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Replaced bin/replay with an Ubuntu 7.10-compatible POSIX shell implementation.
Delivered <a@branch.test> once despite duplicate spool entries.
Delivered <b@branch.test> separately despite sharing the same subject.
Preserved old.eml and all four original spool files.
Quarantined bad.eml with reason: missing Message-ID header.
Normalized delivered/index.tsv and verified repeat runs skip indexed messages.
Restarted node1 and verified recovery under a changed boot identity.

evidence.requirement: Recover pending messages once per Message-ID without conflating equal subjects
evidence.summary: Index contains exactly one entry each for old, a, and b; a and b both retain Subject: Notice as distinct deliveries.

evidence.requirement: Rerunning recovery skips already recorded messages
evidence.summary: Repeat runs skipped both copies of a and b; before/after content hashes were identical.

evidence.requirement: Preserve original spool and already-delivered message
evidence.summary: Original and final hashes match for all spool messages and delivered/old.eml.

evidence.requirement: Quarantine malformed messages with an explanation
evidence.summary: bad.eml is preserved in quarantine with a companion reason stating that its Message-ID header is missing.

evidence.requirement: Retain installed operating-system release and kernel
